title: Signed source envelope (ADR-127)
description: At most 1500 KiB UTF-8; verify original decoded payload before use.

format.description: Signed format; independent of SDK version.

payload.description: Canonical Base64 of signed-script-payload JSON bytes, at most 1 MiB decoded.

signature.description: Canonical Base64 of 64-byte Ed25519 signature over domain, NUL, raw SHA-256 of the payload.
